import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_LIMIT = 2000010;
    static final long MOD_A = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD_B = 998244353L;
    static final long BASE_NUM = 1000000L;
    static long total_nums = 0;
    static long total_ans = 0;
    static long[] prefix_sum_arr = new long[10];
    static List<Long>[] digit_buckets = new ArrayList[10];
    static long n;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            digit_buckets[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long input(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        String line = br.readLine();
        return Long.parseLong(line.trim());
    }

    static long mod_calc(long x) {
        long res = x % MOD_B;
        if (res < 0) res += MOD_B;
        return res;
    }

    static void build_sequence(long start, int depth) {
        total_nums++;
        digit_buckets[depth].add(mod_calc(total_nums - start));
        total_ans = (total_ans + digit_buckets[depth].get(digit_buckets[depth].size() - 1)) % MOD_A;
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
            build_sequence(start * 10 + d, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void traverse(long num) {
        if (num > n) return;
        if (num * BASE_NUM + (BASE_NUM - 1) <= n && num * BASE_NUM * 10 > n) {
            long prev_idx = total_nums;
            for (int level = 0, mult = 1; level <= 6; level++, mult *= 10) {
                int size = digit_buckets[level].size();
                long delta = mod_calc(prev_idx - num * mult);
                int pos = lowerBound(digit_buckets[level], MOD_B - delta);
                total_ans = (total_ans + delta * size + prefix_sum_arr[level] - MOD_A * (size - pos)) % MOD_A;
                total_nums += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        total_nums++;
        total_ans = (total_ans + mod_calc(total_nums - num)) % MOD_A;
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
            traverse(num * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = input(br);
        build_sequence(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(digit_buckets[i]);
        }
        total_nums = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            traverse(i);
        }
        System.out.println((total_ans + MOD_A) % MOD_A);
    }
}
